metadata.title: Presence-Gate Reference Components — Location-Aware Access Control for Delegated Agent Traffic
metadata.remarks: Reference component definitions for the oscal-presence-gate PoC. Each component maps its implemented requirements to the PRES overlay catalog and, where applicable, to the unofficial CISA Security Requirements encoding.

components.title: presence-attestation-service
components.description: Issues and re-issues signed, short-TTL presence assertions for a human principal at task initiation and on re-attestation. Sources: GPS attestation via authenticator app (with device-integrity checks) or verified network evidence. Publishes assertions for binding into delegation chains.

control-implementations.description: Implements the presence-claim issuance half of the PRES overlay.

implemented-requirements.description: Issues attested presence assertions carrying source, issuance timestamp, and max-age; refuses issuance when device-integrity checks fail, so downstream evaluation degrades to location-unknown (deny for covered data).
Supports re-attestation flows so delegations and long-lived connections can extend only against fresh presence.

components.title: location-gate-middleware
components.description: Enforcement dependency for covered endpoints (reference implementation targets FastAPI). Evaluates the principal's presence assertion from the delegation chain — never the workload's network position alone — against the blocked-country parameter; fails closed on unknown; exempts only traffic classified as fully autonomous under PRES-4; emits structured decision records.

implemented-requirements.description: Evaluates assertion freshness locally (microsecond budget); stale or absent assertion is treated as location unknown.
Denies covered-data requests attributable to principals in blocked countries or with unknown location; retains workload-IP checks as defense-in-depth only.
Classifies traffic by principal reachability, not grant type.
Emits decision records with correlation IDs propagated across the delegation chain.

control-implementations.description: Contributes to the keystone CISA access-control requirement and its logging expectation.

implemented-requirements.description: Extends logical access control to delegated traffic so covered persons and countries of concern cannot obtain covered data through agents acting on a principal's behalf.
Decision records feed central log storage meeting the twelve-month retention minimum.

components.title: delivery-surface-gate
components.description: Rendering-side enforcement for agent outputs: before covered data renders on a chat surface, notification, message, or export, verifies the recipient's presence assertion and either gates the rendering in-band or withholds covered content from ungated surfaces.

control-implementations.description: Implements the delivery half of PRES-2 and lifetime bounds of PRES-3.

implemented-requirements.description: Enforces recipient-location verification at render time — the point where access legally occurs under the DSP's definition.
Applies maximum ages to open delivery channels tied to the attestation window.
